covers: The JSE close and Wall Street trade to 19:11 SAST on Monday 9 November, against Friday 6 November closes. Prices only: today's news stories could not be opened and checked for this edition, so they are left out until they are verified.
headline: Breaking: AMD up 11.5% and Nvidia down 4.8% as Wall Street extends gains; S&P 500 +2.3% to 7,546
summary: In South Africa the JSE All Share closed the session at 115,037.93 (+2.0% on Friday) and the Top 40 at 107,087.60 (+2.3%), with the rand at R16.42/$ (-0.3%) (Yahoo Finance via LRC Market Dashboard, 9 Nov). In the US the S&P 500 was at 7,545.59 (+2.3%) and the Nasdaq at 25,229.36 (+2.6%) at 19:11 SAST, with chip stocks leading but Nvidia falling 4.8% to $177.77, further below its $191.50 breakdown level. Brent was at $93.85 (-4.5%) while gold ($4,119.50, +1.1%), platinum (+1.8%) and copper (+2.1%) held gains, ahead of US October CPI on Tuesday at 15:30 SAST.

items.title: AMD +11.5% to $500.88 and Nvidia -4.8% to $177.77 at 19:11 SAST
items.summary: Two covered chip stocks are moving more than 5% in opposite directions. AMD extends Friday's 11.0% rebound and is now well above its LRC Stock Scanner target of $386.50; Nvidia is the main laggard in a broad rally and sits 7% below its $191.50 breakdown level and 24% below its $233.80 target. We could not open and verify today's news reports on the reasons, so they are left out for now. Both ratings stay HOLD.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner, live prices at 19:11 SAST, 9 Nov 2026 (change vs 6 Nov close)
